sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "roller_coaster"."Country_ID" AS e, AVG("roller_coaster"."Speed") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("roller_coaster"."Length" - "roller_coaster"."Height") AS REAL) / "roller_coaster"."Height")) AS m2 FROM "roller_coaster" GROUP BY "roller_coaster"."Country_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m2" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
